scenarios.name: Vision model, new chat
scenarios.description: Qwen2.5-VL selected; empty chat; Image control visible, Audio control absent; format/size/one-file hint shown

scenarios.name: Text-only model
scenarios.description: Granite selected; no Image or Audio controls in the DOM; capability shows Text only

scenarios.name: File too large
scenarios.description: Vision model; danger helper text 'street-scene.png is 14.2 MB, limit is 10 MB'; nothing uploaded

scenarios.name: Image sent, generating
scenarios.description: User message with inline image; assistant 'Generating response' spinner with 120 s timeout note

scenarios.name: Image answered
scenarios.description: Inline image plus non-empty model answer; '1 of 1 file used' indicator on controls

scenarios.name: Model rejected image
scenarios.description: Inline image followed by danger alert: model rejected image input at inference time, suggest switching model

scenarios.name: Second file blocked
scenarios.description: Answered image conversation with warning alert: only one image or audio file per conversation, Start new chat action

scenarios.name: Audio, no transcription model
scenarios.description: Gemma (image + audio) selected; WAV attached; transcription dropdown empty; warning alert to register an ASR AI asset; Send disabled

scenarios.name: Transcribing audio
scenarios.description: Audio message sent; progress stepper Uploading done, Transcribing audio in progress, Generating pending

scenarios.name: Audio answered
scenarios.description: Audio player with transcription text, followed by non-empty model answer; whisper-large-v3 shown as transcription model

scenarios.name: Transcription failed
scenarios.description: Audio message with danger alert 'Transcription failed: whisper-large-v3 is unreachable'; no model call made; Retry action

scenarios.name: No speech detected
scenarios.description: Audio message with warning alert 'No speech detected'; empty transcription; no model call made

scenarios.name: Endpoints with ASR flagged
scenarios.description: Five endpoints; whisper-large-v3 and whisper-1 labelled 'Transcription (ASR)'

scenarios.name: No transcription endpoint
scenarios.description: Endpoints listed but none marked ASR; info alert explains Playground audio needs a transcription endpoint

scenarios.name: ASR just marked
scenarios.description: Success alert 'whisper-large-v3 is now available as a transcription model in the Playground'; row label updated

scenarios.name: No AI assets
scenarios.description: Empty state 'No AI asset endpoints' with guidance to deploy or add a custom endpoint

scenarios.name: Load error
scenarios.description: Danger empty state 'Unable to load AI asset endpoints' with Retry
